knowledge_used.how_applied: Procedure steps 1-9 executed for the C4MS025120K: device gate data collected from the Rev. 2 datasheet, isolation chosen for the 460 V switch node, rails +15/-4 V, driver features selected, R_G from datasheet curves, DESAT with CB-GD-001 formulas, discharge resistor, decoupling from Q_G, interlock/fault interface, hand-off to SKILL-002. Reference instance values (2 ohm, 1 ohm, 10 ohm, 6.4 V/1 us, 6.7 V/46 ns, 20 uF) were not copied.

Positions grouped by reference (HS: switch node; LS: PGND), power per supply computed with KR-IS-001, topology chosen with the PRD-04814 comparison (integrated module selected, LLC kept as fallback), rails generated by the module's regulated VDD/COM/VEE outputs, CM choke and decoupling added, isolation and i_CM estimated, PG/UVLO interaction defined. Bootstrap excluded per the skill's scope.
Used only to formulate the layout hand-off (net classes, gate/Kelvin pours, decoupling in the loop, DESAT routing, probe points); actual placement/routing belongs to the PCB agent.
Only the principle that an NTC reads heat-sink/case temperature, not junction temperature, is used for the AIN/APWM channel; thermal budgeting is the MOSFET/thermal agents' area.
Sensing design belongs to the sensing agent; only the sensing-supply tap on the LS bias supply (TIDA decision 7 pattern) is budgeted here.

Rails +15 V/-4 V with +/-1.3 % regulation plus estimated gate-loop overshoot (< 0.5 V, overdamped loop) checked against the C4MS025120K absolute maxima -10/+23 V read from its datasheet and against the C3M fallback -8/+19 V; measurement at the device side of R_G required.
Split OUTH/OUTL of the UCC21710-Q1 with separate R_G,ON = 10 ohm (6.8 ohm tuning target) and R_G,OFF = 3.3 ohm; steering-diode variant (CB-GD-002) not needed.

Parasitic turn-on excursion computed two ways (R-limited and capacitance-divider-limited) for C_iss/C_rss = 630, -4 V bias and the 6.2 ohm off-path: 0.6-1.0 V excursion, so the device is inherently immune; the internal clamp (0 ohm CLMPI link, short path) is still populated as a no-cost margin. Conflict preserved: Wolfspeed says the clamp is not strictly needed with low R_G and low-inductance routing.

Trip V_DS = 3.6 V (3.2-4.0 V over V_OCTH tolerance) derived from the C4MS025120K 175 degC output curve (about 75 A at V_GS = 15 V) and the diode drop; blanking 252-326 ns derived from the turn-on settling estimate. TI's 6.4 V/1 us and Wolfspeed's 6.7 V/46 ns were not reused. Values must be confirmed on hardware.
Negative -4 V turn-off kept for both half-bridge positions; the 0 V alternative is discussed and rejected because the computed excursion (about 1 V) would leave only 1 V to the 2.0 V hot threshold.
The UCC14141-Q1 feedback dividers make +15/-4 V (C4MS and C3M compatible) and +18/-4 V (C4MS only) population options; the DESAT blanking shift with VDD is quantified (288 ns -> 229 ns).
10 kohm gate-to-Kelvin-source resistor at the device side of R_G (10 k vs 47 k alternative noted; 10 k chosen for a 3 ms-class discharge with C_iss 3.1 nF and 11 mW dissipation).

On one integrated board the PWM links are short single-ended 3.3 V lines with RC filters at the IC pins (allowed by PRD-09301 section 4.1); if the architecture agent separates the boards with a cable, the CB-GD-003 RS-422 interface must be added. Both options kept.
IN+/IN- cross-wiring of the HS and LS drivers as hardware interlock; dead time generated by the F28335 ePWM dead-band (250 ns bring-up, 150-200 ns target, derived from skew and gate timing).
Optional gate-Kelvin RC footprint (DNP) is provided only because the TO-247-4 has a Kelvin source; any population must be reviewed with double-pulse data.
UCC21710-Q1 400 mA soft turn-off selected over the UCC21732-Q1 two-level turn-off; fault overshoot estimated at 684 V worst case against the 1200 V rating.
No gate-Kelvin Zener; transient control by rails, damping (zeta 1.6-3.8) and layout.

P = Q_G*f_sw*(VDD-VEE) = 0.119 W plus quiescent, DESAT bias and the LS sensing-LDO load (0.615 W) compared with the UCC14141-Q1 ratings at the actual input range and temperature (1.5 W at 25 degC; 1.2 W at 85 degC for 11.4-12.6 V).
Wuerth 744226S (10 uH, 1.6 A) at each module input with 2 x 10 uF between choke and module.
i_CM = C_iso*dv/dt computed per candidate (UCC14141 < 3.5 pF: 0.42 A; RECOM < 10 pF: 1.2 A; LLC transformer 0.68 pF: 0.08 A) for the HS position at 120 V/ns.

The LS bias module also feeds the isolated-sensing LDO (two AMC1311 class loads) as in TIDA decision 7; flagged for review of the combined budget, RLIM setting and an alternative dedicated 5 V module.
Regulated module (+/-1.3 % over line, load and temperature) chosen so no LDO post-regulation is needed; accuracy requirement set to +/-5 % (PRD-04814) and met with margin.

Total response blanking + detection + soft turn-off = 0.55-1.07 us computed from datasheet min/max values; Wolfspeed publishes no withstand time for C4MS025120K (press statements 'about 2 us' / 'up to 2.3 us' for Gen 4, conditions unknown). Short-circuit test and Wolfspeed confirmation required.
FLT latched in the driver until RST/EN low >= 1 us; FLT_HS/FLT_LS wired-AND to TZ1, RDY_HS, RDY_LS and both bias PG signals combined to TZ2; outputs held low during UVLO.

Auxiliary 12 V input protection is the auxiliary/protection agent's block (CB-PR-001); this design states the downstream requirement: UCC14141 UVLO 8.2 V rising / OVLO 22 V, so an eFuse OVP at <= 18 V and UVLO >= 9 V are compatible.
Hand-off: gate and Kelvin-source as adjacent-layer pours, Kelvin layer shielding the gate.
Decoupling sized from Q_G (2 x 4.7 uF + 100 nF on VDD-COM, 4.7 uF + 100 nF on COM-VEE) placed between IC and gate/Kelvin pins; the CGD1700 20 uF per rail was not copied.
COM/VEE return only to the TO-247-4 driver-source pin; netlist check that Kelvin-source and power-source nets are distinct.
Driver IC within about 15 mm of the gate/Kelvin pins; V_GS probe point at the device side of R_G.
Three copper-free barriers: control/HS island, control/LS island, HS island/LS island; only UCC21710 and UCC14141 bridge them.

Working voltage 460 V DC class; preliminary IEC 60664-1 figures (10 mm reinforced creepage for 500 V, PD2, material group IIIa; 5.5 mm clearance for 6 kV impulse) given for the architecture/insulation review, not decided here.
Seven net classes defined: CONTROL, HS_DRV, LS_DRV, HS_DESAT_MID, LS_DESAT_MID, HV_DRAIN (VIN+), SW.
A routed slot under the SOIC-16 DW / DWN-36 bodies is proposed because the package pad span (about 8 mm) is below the preliminary 10 mm reinforced PCB creepage.

UCC21710-Q1 (VDE 0884-17 reinforced, UL 1577 5.7 kVrms) and UCC14141-Q1 (certifications listed as 'planned' in SLUSF10B) checked against a 460 V DC working voltage; the certificate status of the UCC14141-Q1 must be confirmed by the reviewer.
Topology and the trip/blanking formulas (EC-001/EC-002 pattern) used; every value re-derived for the C4MS025120K (R1 2.2 k, R2 4.99 k, R3 1.0 k, C 680 pF, one 1000 V diode).
Steering-diode turn-off path is unnecessary with split outputs.
Fault combination and fail-safe idea reused; RS-422 transceivers only if the architecture uses cables; filter time constants re-derived against the 100 ns minimum pulse and 150-250 ns dead time.

UCC14141-Q1 per channel configured for +15/-4 V with re-derived dividers (107 k/16.2 k and 9.76 k/16.2 k, 0.1 %); TI's RLIM values not copied, RLIM derived from the datasheet procedure (human review).
SIP module + LDO path rejected (RECOM gives -3 V, Murata -5 V, both unregulated); kept as documented alternative.
Open-loop LLC (UCC25800-Q1 + 750319177) retained only as the fallback if the UCC14141 SOA check fails; lowest C_iso (0.68 pF) noted.
Zener split not needed because the module regulates VDD-COM and COM-VEE directly.

LS driver AIN/APWM used for a heat-sink NTC; the network (3.3 k series + 10 k parallel + 10 nF) re-derived so V_AIN stays within 0.6-4.5 V from -40 to 125 degC with the 200 uA source; Wolfspeed's 2.2 k/10 nF and TI's TMP6131 not copied.
Auxiliary input protection is another agent's block; interface thresholds stated.

Re-verified against SLUSDH8D (June 2024): the knowledge record's 5.7 kVrms, 1.5 kVrms working, 10 A, 150 V/ns, 0.63/0.7/0.77 V, 270 ns, 400 mA, 4 A clamp, 130 ns figures all confirmed; UVLO 12 V, deglitch 120 ns and skew 30 ns added.

Re-verified against SLUSF10B: 1.5 W (10.8-13.2 V), 15-25 V adjustable +/-1.3 %, CIO < 3.5 pF, VIOWM 1000 Vrms; the rating's temperature dependence (1.2 W at 85 degC) found to matter for the LS budget.
Evaluated as alternative: -3 V output, unregulated, < 10 pF series capacitance; rejected for this design.
Family member MGJ2D121505SC (+15/-5 V) evaluated; -5 V sits at the C4MS limit and outside the C3M recommendation; rejected.
Fallback LLC bias (with CMP-750319177) if the integrated module's derated power is insufficient.
No DESAT/soft turn-off; violates KR-PR-001 for a product design.

Decision 4 (one isolated driver + one integrated bias module per switch) adopted structurally; decision 5 values (2 ohm, US1Q, 100 pF) replaced by derived ones; decision 7 (sensing LDO from LS bias) adopted with its power consequence quantified; decision 8 thresholds used as interface requirement.

Decisions 1-5, 7, 8 used as patterns (split outputs, DESAT network topology, soft shutdown/latched fault, interlock, CM choke, gate/Kelvin routing, NTC via APWM); module-level values (1 ohm, 6.7 V, 46 ns, 20 uF, 2 x US3M) not transferred.

Decisions 3-6: LLC fallback, source-referenced decoupling at the output pins, Miller-clamp path length argument, 47 k vs 10 k pull-down conflict preserved; 10 ohm/+15/-3.3 V instance values not copied.
Decision 1 levels (+15 V, -3 to -4 V, +/-5 %) adopted as -4 V with +/-1.3 % actual; decision 2/3 used for topology and C_iso; decision 6 for the optional gate-Kelvin RC.
Gate-loop minimisation turned into concrete constraints (driver distance, adjacent-layer pair, decoupling inside loop) for human review.
Control-side logic (fault AND, RC filters) kept on the SELV side away from the switch node.
Per-pin decoupling map given for UCC21710 (VCC, VDD, VEE) and UCC14141 (VIN, VDD-VEE, COM-VEE, FB caps).

selection.architecture: One reinforced-isolated driver (UCC21710-Q1) plus one isolated regulated bias module (UCC14141-Q1) per switch position; identical HS and LS channels except the LS channel carries the heat-sink NTC on AIN/APWM and feeds the isolated-sensing 5 V LDO from its +15 V rail (TIDA decision 7 pattern, KR-IS-004 review). driver.VCC: 3.3 V (F28335 I/O level; VINH max 2.31 V, VINL min 0.99 V at 3.3 V)
driver.inputs: IN+ = own PWM, IN- = complementary PWM (cross-wired interlock, KR-GD-009); 100 ohm + 100 pF at each pin (tau 10 ns)
driver.fault_lines: FLT (open drain, latched) and RDY (power good) per driver; APWM from LS driver
driver.reset: RST/EN from GPIO, active-low pulse >= 1 us; low also disables

gate_rails.device_limits: C4MS025120K recommended +15..+18 / -5..0 V, absolute -10/+23 V; C3M0021120K fallback -4/+15 recommended, -8/+19 absolute
gate_rails.option: +18 V (C4MS only) by changing the FBVDD top resistor to 127 k (KR-GD-006); blanking changes 288 ns -> 229 ns
gate_rails.why_negative: computed off-state excursion 0.6-1.0 V (capacitance-divider bound 400 V/630) versus a 2.0 V typical threshold at 175 degC: 0 V turn-off would leave only about 1 V margin, -4 V leaves about 5 V (KR-GD-005)
gate_rails.UVLO_match: driver VDD UVLO 10.5-12.8 V on / 9.9-11.8 V off below the 14.8 V minimum rail; UCC14141 PG qualifies both rails (UVP/OVP windows) and is ANDed into the enable path; no VEE UVLO in the driver

gate_resistors.packages: 1206 anti-surge Panasonic ERJ-P08 (0.66 W, 500 V); average 0.04 W each

gate_resistors.miller_clamp: CLMPI to gate through 0 ohm 0603 link, path <= 15 mm; engages below VEE + 2.0 V
gate_resistors.gate_discharge: 10 kohm 0805 gate-to-Kelvin at the device side of R_G (KR-GD-007)
gate_resistors.gate_kelvin_RC: DNP 0603 pads (e.g. 1 ohm + 470 pF) for review only (KR-GD-010)

desat.topology: VDD -> R1 2.2 k -> node A -> US1M (cathode to drain); node A -> R2 4.99 k -> OC; OC -> R3 1.00 k -> COM; C_blank 680 pF C0G OC-COM; Schottky clamp COM->OC (anode at COM)
desat.trip_current: about 75 A (70-85 A) at 175 degC and V_GS = 15 V from datasheet Figure 3, about 135-165 A at 25 degC (Figure 2); 2.4x the 31.6 A overload peak at 175 degC
desat.false_trip_margin: overload V_DS 1.45 V at 175 degC gives OC = 0.34 V versus 0.63 V minimum threshold (1.85x)
desat.blanking: external 252/288/326 ns (V_OCTH min/typ/max) plus IC deglitch 95-180 ns; turn-on settling estimate about 150 ns
desat.response: blanking + tOCOFF + soft turn-off to threshold = 0.55 us min / 0.77 us typ / 1.07 us max (<= 1.5 us budget)
desat.withstand: not specified by Wolfspeed for C4MS025120K; Gen 4 press figures 'about 2 us' / 'up to 2.3 us' (conditions unknown) -> ratio >= 1.9 at the maximum response, human review and short-circuit test required (KR-PR-001)
desat.fault_overshoot: soft turn-off 0.13 V/ns gate slew, channel cut-off about 39 ns at I_sc about 250 A -> di/dt 6.4 A/ns -> 224 V on 35 nH -> 684 V peak at 460 V bus (57 % of 1200 V)
desat.diode: US1M-13-F 1000 V: blocking margin 1.9x at 528 V, bias 6-9 mA, 10 pF adds about 1.5 % to the blanking charge
desat.third_quadrant_note: during dead time the LS drain sits at -4.6 V; node A -> -4.0 V and OC would reach -0.67 V unclamped (abs min -0.3 V), hence the Schottky clamp (0.74 mA); clamp V_F <= 0.3 V to be verified

bias_supply.output_caps: 2 x 4.7 uF (VDD-VEE) + 4.7 uF (COM-VEE) at the module, plus driver-local decoupling

decoupling.VDD_COM: 2 x 4.7 uF 25 V X7R 1206 (TDK C3216X7R1E475K160AC) + 100 nF 0603 at the VDD/COM pins; effective about 6 uF -> 20 mV droop per 125 nC pulse
decoupling.COM_VEE: 4.7 uF 25 V X7R 1206 + 100 nF 0603 at the VEE/COM pins; about 30 mV droop
decoupling.derivation: C_eff >= Q_G/dV = 125 nC / 0.1 V = 1.25 uF, x1.5 for X7R DC bias loss; the CGD1700 20 uF per rail was not copied

dead_time_ns.derivation: part-to-part skew 30 + PWD 30 + td(off) about 50 (R_G,OFF 3.3 ohm) + t_f 13 - td(on) about 28 = 95 ns, x1.5 margin -> 150 ns minimum; 250 ns = 37-38 TBCLK counts at 150 MHz; each 100 ns costs about 1.2 W body-diode loss (MOSFET agent)
dead_time_ns.min_pulse: PWM pulses < 40 ns are rejected by the driver deglitch; keep minimum on-time >= 100 ns

dv_dt_and_CMTI.turn_on_V_per_ns: peak 71 (10 ohm) / 90 (6.8 ohm) at the top of the swing from I_G,plateau / C_rss(400 V); about 41-53 mid-swing
dv_dt_and_CMTI.turn_off_V_per_ns: load-current limited: about 110 at 25 A and 122 at 27.5 A at the top of the swing (I_off / 2 C_oss(400 V)), about 48 average over the swing; R_G,OFF has little influence for this low-C_rss device
dv_dt_and_CMTI.CMTI_margin: 150/120 = 1.25 instantaneous minimum-spec margin, about 3x on the average slope; UCC14141 > 150 kV/us likewise; measurement by double-pulse test mandatory; mitigation if > 120 V/ns: switch-node RC snubber pads (MOSFET agent) or reviewed gate-Kelvin C (KR-GD-010), not a lower-CMTI driver

interface_to_controller.TZ1: FLT_HS and FLT_LS wired-AND (open drain), 4.7 k pull-up to 3.3 V, 1 k/1 nF filter (active-low trip)
interface_to_controller.TZ2: RDY_HS AND RDY_LS AND NOT(PG_HS) AND NOT(PG_LS) through a 3-input AND + inverters (SN74LVC1G11 / SN74LVC2G04 class), active-low trip when any rail is not ready
interface_to_controller.eCAP1: APWM of the LS driver (380-420 kHz, duty 88 % at 0.6 V to 10 % at 4.5 V) -> heat-sink temperature
interface_to_controller.GPIO: RST/EN (shared or per driver), UCC14141 ENA
interface_to_controller.firmware_contract: ePWM complementary pair with DBRED = DBFED = 250 ns at bring-up; TZ one-shot forces both outputs low; after a trip firmware waits >= 1 ms fault-mute, pulses RST/EN low >= 1 us, checks RDY/PG and re-arms; APWM decoded by period/duty capture

selection.nets_and_classes: CONTROL (SELV), HS_DRV (COM_HS = SW Kelvin), LS_DRV (COM_LS = PGND Kelvin), HS_DESAT_MID, LS_DESAT_MID, HV_DRAIN (VIN+ via HS DESAT diode), SW; Kelvin-source nets never joined to power-source nets on the PCB (KR-PCB-003)

per_channel_bom.rating: 30 V, VF <= 0.3 V at 0.7 mA to verify

per_channel_bom.ref: C_VDD1, C_VDD2, C_VEE1, C_OUT1, C_OUT2, C_OUT3

per_channel_bom.value: per datasheet procedure (1 kohm start, HS; lower for LS)
4.7 k pull-ups FLT/RDY, 1 k + 1 nF RST/EN filter
V_GS probe at device side of R_G
3.3 k series, 10 k parallel to NTC, 10 nF

calculations.name: Gate-charge bias power per channel (KR-IS-001)
calculations.expression: P_g = Q_G * f_sw * (V_DD - V_EE)
calculations.result: 0.119 W (Q_G at -4/+15 V read from Figure 12 is about 105 nC -> 0.100 W; 125 nC used as budget)

calculations.name: Driver quiescent and DESAT bias power
calculations.expression: P_q = I_VDDQ,max * 19 V ; P_DESAT = I_R1,avg * V_DD ; I_R1 = (V_DD - V_A)/R1 during on-state, (V_DD - 0.13)/(R1 + R2) during off-state
calculations.result: P_q = 0.112 W; I_R1 = 5.9/2.1 mA (HS) and 7.2/2.1 mA (LS) -> 0.06-0.07 W; pull-down and AIN 0.015 W

calculations.name: Total load per bias supply and utilisation
calculations.expression: P_HS = P_g + P_q + P_DESAT + P_misc ; P_LS = P_HS + (I_LDO + I_q,LDO) * V_DD
calculations.result: P_HS = 0.32 W (27 % of 1.2 W); P_LS = 0.93 W (78 % of 1.2 W, exceeds the 0.7 W wide-input figure) -> SOA check at 10.8 V required; with a dedicated sensing supply P_LS = 0.32 W

calculations.name: Bias input current from 12 V
calculations.expression: I_in ~ interpolated from datasheet (40 mA no load, 200 mA at 1.0 W)
calculations.result: about 0.09 A + 0.19 A = 0.28 A (3.4 W) of the 2 A auxiliary budget

calculations.name: UCC14141 feedback dividers
calculations.expression: V_out = 2.5 V * (1 + R_top/R_bot)
calculations.result: 19.01 V, 4.006 V, 22.10 V (all inside the 15-25 V range); divider current 0.15 mA
calculations.knowledge_ref: SLUSF10B FBVDD/FBVEE pin descriptions (2.5 V reference)

calculations.name: Rail decoupling from gate charge (KR-PCB-002)
calculations.expression: C_eff >= Q_G / dV ; C_nom = C_eff / (1 - k_bias)
calculations.result: C_eff >= 1.25 uF -> C_nom >= 1.9 uF -> 2 x 4.7 uF on VDD-COM (droop 20 mV), 1 x 4.7 uF on COM-VEE (30 mV) + 100 nF each

calculations.name: Peak gate currents
calculations.expression: I_pk,on = 19 V / (R_ON + R_int + R_OUTH) ; I_pk,off = 19 V / (R_OFF + R_int + R_OUTL)

calculations.name: Gate resistor power and pulse
calculations.expression: P_R = 0.5 * Q_G * dV * f_sw * R/(R_total) ; P_pulse = I_pk^2 * R
calculations.result: R_ON 0.039 W average, 16 W for about 30 ns; R_OFF 0.032 W, 31 W for about 20 ns -> 1206 anti-surge 0.66 W adequate

calculations.name: Turn-on dv/dt envelope (gate-current / C_rss model)
calculations.expression: dv/dt = (V_DD - V_pl) / ((R_ON + R_int + R_OUTH) * C_rss(V_DS))

inputs.C_rss_400V_pF: 7 (datasheet 4.7 pF at 1000 V; curve not digitised)

calculations.result: 71 V/ns peak at 10 ohm, 90 V/ns at 6.8 ohm; 41-53 V/ns mid-swing

calculations.name: Turn-off dv/dt envelope (load-current limited)
calculations.expression: dv/dt = I_off / (C_oss,HS(V) + C_oss,LS(V)) ; cross-check t_v = 2 E_off / (V I)

inputs.C_oss_400V_pF: 130 each (103 pF at 1000 V, Co(tr) 238 pF)

calculations.result: 110-122 V/ns at the top of the swing, about 48 V/ns average; datasheet-derived t_v about 4 ns at 800 V/1 ohm (195 V/ns) scales to about 100 V/ns at 400 V/28.75 A - consistent

calculations.name: CMTI margin
calculations.expression: m = CMTI_min / dv/dt_envelope
calculations.result: 1.25 (instantaneous peak) / 3.1 (average); UCC5870 (100) and Si8285 (125) fall below 1.1 at the peak

calculations.name: Common-mode current through the bias and driver barriers (KR-IS-003)
calculations.expression: i_CM = (C_IO,bias + C_IO,driver) * dv/dt
calculations.result: 0.54 A per edge (UCC14141 + driver), 1.3 A (RECOM + driver), 0.2 A (LLC + driver); about 4 ns pulses, 2 nC per edge; LS position negligible (COM = PGND)

calculations.name: Parasitic turn-on excursion (KR-GD-003)
calculations.expression: dV_R = C_rss * dv/dt * R_path ; dV_C = dV_DS / (C_iss/C_rss) ; actual ~ min of both
calculations.result: R-limited 6.0 V (no clamp) / 3.1 V (clamp); capacitance-divider bound 0.63 V -> real excursion about 0.6-1.0 V: -4 V -> about -3 V versus V_GS(th) 2.0 V hot; with 0 V bias only about 1 V margin

calculations.name: Gate-loop damping and V_GS extremes (KR-GD-001)
calculations.expression: Z0 = sqrt(L_g/C_iss) ; zeta = R_total/(2 Z0)
calculations.result: Z0 = 2.0 ohm; zeta 3.8 (on) / 1.6 (off) -> overshoot < 0.5 V; extremes about +15.7 V / -4.6 V versus -10/+23 V (C4MS) and -8/+19 V (C3M)

calculations.name: DESAT trip voltage (CB-GD-001)
calculations.expression: V_A = V_OCTH * (R2 + R3)/R3 ; V_DS,trip = V_A - n * V_F

calculations.name: DESAT trip current from the output curves
calculations.expression: I_trip = I_D where V_DS(I_D, T_J, 15 V) = V_DS,trip
calculations.result: about 70-85 A at 175 degC (75 A nominal, 3.0x rated, 2.4x overload peak); about 135-165 A at 25 degC

calculations.name: False-trip margin at overload
calculations.expression: V_OC = (V_DS,ovl + V_F) * R3/(R2 + R3)
calculations.result: 0.34 V versus 0.63 V minimum threshold -> 1.85x

calculations.name: External blanking time (CB-GD-001)
calculations.expression: t_bl = -R3 (R1+R2)/(R1+R2+R3) * C * ln(1 - (R1+R2+R3)/R3 * V_OCTH/V_DD)
calculations.result: V_th 1.831 V, R_th 878 ohm; 252/288/326 ns for V_OCTH min/typ/max; + IC deglitch 95-180 ns; 229 ns typ at V_DD = 18 V

calculations.name: Turn-on settling versus blanking
calculations.expression: t_settle = td(on) + t_vfall + t_ring ; f_ring = 1/(2 pi sqrt(L_loop C_oss))
calculations.result: f_ring 82 MHz, about 8 cycles 100 ns -> about 150 ns < 252 ns minimum blanking (1.7x)

calculations.name: Total protection response (KR-PR-001)
calculations.expression: t_resp = t_bl + t_OCOFF + Q(15 V -> 3 V)/I_STO
calculations.result: 0.55 us min / 0.77 us typ / 1.07 us max <= 1.5 us budget; versus unpublished withstand (press: about 2-2.3 us for Gen 4) ratio >= 1.9

calculations.name: Fault turn-off overshoot
calculations.expression: dV_GS/dt = I_STO/C_iss ; di/dt = I_sc / (5 V / (dV_GS/dt)) ; V_pk = V_bus + L_loop di/dt
calculations.result: 0.13 V/ns, about 39 ns cut-off, 6.4 A/ns, 224 V -> 684 V peak (57 % of 1200 V)

calculations.name: OC-pin excursion during third-quadrant conduction
calculations.expression: V_OC = (V_SD + V_F) * R3/(R2+R3) unclamped ; I_clamp = (|V_A| - V_F,cl)/R2
calculations.result: -0.67 V unclamped (abs min -0.3 V) -> Schottky clamp needed, 0.74 mA
calculations.knowledge_ref: CGD1700HB2M-UNA decision 2 (clamp diode DT5 pattern); SLUSDH8D abs max

calculations.name: Dead-time requirement (KR-GD-009)
calculations.expression: t_dt >= skew + PWD + td(off) + t_f - td(on) ; x1.5 margin
calculations.result: 95 ns -> 150 ns minimum; 250 ns bring-up (37.5 counts at 150 MHz), 400 ns upper bound; cost about 1.2 W per 100 ns
calculations.knowledge_ref: KR-GD-009, SLUSDH8D switching characteristics, C4MS025120K Figure 27

calculations.name: E_on penalty of the external gate resistor
calculations.expression: k_RG = E_on(R_G,ext)/E_on(1 ohm) from Figure 25
calculations.result: about 1.6 / 1.9 (versus 1.3 assumed by the MOSFET agent) -> about +2.4 / +3.8 W HS switching loss at 400 V/25 A
calculations.knowledge_ref: SKILL-006 principle 3 (hand-off to the efficiency budget)

calculations.name: Insulation coordination check
calculations.expression: m_w = V_IOWM,DC / V_working ; impulse requirement per IEC 60664-1 (600 V system, OVC II): 4 kV basic, 6 kV reinforced
calculations.result: working-voltage margin 4.6x / 3.1x; impulse 8.0 / 7.7 kV versus 6 kV; preliminary PCB figures 10 mm reinforced creepage (PD2, group IIIa) and 5.5 mm clearance - for the insulation review

calculations.name: NTC network on AIN
calculations.expression: V_AIN = I_AIN * (R_ser + R_NTC(T) || R_par) ; R_NTC = 10 k exp(B (1/T - 1/298))
calculations.result: 2.6 V at -40 degC, 1.66 V at 25 degC, 0.79 V at 100 degC, 0.73 V at 125 degC -> inside the 0.6-4.5 V range; duty 86-48 %

pcb_constraints: KR-PCB-005 / PE-PCB-001: each UCC21710 within about 15 mm of its TO-247-4 gate and driver-source pins; R_ON, R_OFF, R_CLMP link and R_GS at the device end; V_GS probe point (MMCX or test pins) at the device side of R_G.

KR-PCB-001: gate and Kelvin-source routed as wide pours on adjacent layers over the whole driver-to-device path, Kelvin pour between the gate pour and any other copper; no vias in the gate path other than the layer pair transition.

KR-PCB-002 / PE-PCB-008: 2 x 4.7 uF + 100 nF (VDD-COM) and 4.7 uF + 100 nF (COM-VEE) placed between the UCC21710 output pins and the gate/Kelvin connection so the gate current loop closes through them; 1 uF + 100 nF at VCC/GND; UCC14141 output capacitors adjacent to VDD/COM/VEE pins, 330 pF FB capacitors at FBVDD/FBVEE/VEEA.

KR-PCB-003: COM/VEE return connected only to the TO-247-4 driver-source (Kelvin) pin; the PCB must not join the Kelvin-source net to the power-source net (netlist check); the LS Kelvin net is a separate net from PGND copper even though both are at PGND potential.

KR-ISO-001: no copper on any layer across the CONTROL/HS_DRV, CONTROL/LS_DRV and HS_DRV/LS_DRV barriers; only UCC21710 and UCC14141 bodies bridge them; the CM choke and 10 uF input capacitors sit on the CONTROL side right at the UCC14141 VIN pin (KR-IS-002).

KR-ISO-002 / KR-ISO-004: preliminary 10 mm reinforced creepage and 5.5 mm clearance between CONTROL and each driver island (460 V DC working voltage, PD2, group IIIa); routed slots under the SOIC-16 DW and DWN-36 bodies where the pad span (about 8 mm) is below the PCB creepage requirement; final distances from the architecture/insulation review.

KR-ISO-003: net classes CONTROL, HS_DRV, LS_DRV, HS_DESAT_MID, LS_DESAT_MID, HV_DRAIN, SW with class-pair clearance rules; the DESAT diode anode nets (HS_DESAT_MID, LS_DESAT_MID) carry bus voltage when the device is off and keep full HV spacing to the driver island nets.

DESAT routing (PRD-09301 section 6.4): US1M cathode by a short direct trace to the drain pin/tab; R1, R2, R3, C_BL and the Schottky clamp compact at the OC pin and shielded by the Kelvin pour; blanking capacitor directly at OC/COM.
Miller clamp (KR-GD-003, PRD-06933): CLMPI link to the gate <= 15 mm, routed with the gate pour; clamp return is the same Kelvin pour.

PE-PCB-007: fault AND/inverter logic, pull-ups and RC filters on the CONTROL side; PWM, FLT, RDY, RST/EN, APWM traces routed away from the switch node and with the CONTROL ground as return; RC filters at the IC pins.

Thermal: UCC14141 (up to about 1.3 W input loss at the LS channel) needs copper area on both sides with vias per the SLUSF10B layout guidance; keep it out of the heat-sink airflow shadow; NTC lug under the LS device mounting screw, leads twisted and routed to the LS driver AIN away from the switch node.

Board partition compatibility: if the architecture agent separates control and power boards, the PWM/FLT/RDY/APWM lines cross a connector - add the CB-GD-003 RS-422 interface (SN65C1167 class) and filters; if one integrated board, keep single-ended links < 100 mm with filters at the driver pins (KR-GD-008).
open_issues: LS bias power budget: 0.93 W (with the 41 mA sensing-LDO load) against a UCC14141-Q1 rating that is 1.5 W only at 25 degC and 1.2 W at 85 degC for 11.4-12.6 V; the 10.8 V / 50 degC corner is not tabulated. Options: read the 19 V SOA curve and set RLIM accordingly, give the sensing a dedicated 1 W isolated 5 V module, or replace the LDO by a small buck (LS load about 0.55 W). Decision requested from the sensing/architecture agents.

Short-circuit withstand time of the C4MS025120K is not published; the 0.55-1.07 us protection response is set conservatively and a destructive short-circuit test on real devices plus a Wolfspeed statement are required before product release (KR-PR-001).

Turn-off dv/dt envelope (110-122 V/ns at the top of the swing at 25-27.5 A) leaves only 1.25x on the 150 V/ns CMTI minimum; the MOSFET agent estimated 20-40 V/ns for turn-off, which this analysis does not reproduce. Double-pulse measurement with an isolated probe decides whether snubber pads or a reviewed gate-Kelvin capacitor are populated.

Gate-resistor loss factor: the MOSFET agent's k_RG = 1.3 corresponds to about 3-4 ohm on the datasheet Figure 25; at the 10 ohm bring-up value the HS switching loss is about 3.8 W higher, at 6.8 ohm about 2.4 W higher. The efficiency budget must absorb this or accept faster edges.
UCC14141-Q1 isolation certifications were 'planned' in SLUSF10B (June 2023); the current VDE/UL certificate status must be confirmed for the insulation file (KR-SN-001).
RLIM value for both channels must be computed with the datasheet 'RLIM Resistor Selection' procedure (not extracted here); TI's 1 k / 600 ohm instance values are not adopted.
OC-pin negative clamp: the Schottky's V_F at 0.74 mA must be <= 0.3 V (OC absolute minimum -0.3 V); BAT42W-V is not verified for this, a lower-V_F part may be needed.

DESAT trip current depends on T_J (about 75 A hot, about 150 A cold); the controller's cycle-by-cycle current limit (sensing agent) must act at 35-40 A for inductor-limited overloads; DESAT is the hard-fault backstop only.

PCB creepage/clearance figures (10 mm / 5.5 mm) are preliminary from IEC 60664-1 and must be set by the architecture/insulation review; the SOIC-16 DW pad span may force slots or a basic-insulation classification with additional protective measures.
AIN of the HS driver is unused: the datasheet recommendation for an unused AIN pin was not extracted; a 4.99 k to COM (1.0 V) is proposed pending check. Optional second NTC on the HS driver is DNP.

Several passive parts (BAT42W-V, 0.1 % feedback resistors, 680 pF C0G, 10 uF 1210, logic gates) are generic catalog parts with unverified datasheets; procurement must confirm ratings before BOM release.
If the architecture agent selects separate boards, the signal interface changes to differential (CB-GD-003) and the RST/EN and fault filters must be re-derived for cable lengths.

# Isolated SiC gate-driver stage and gate-bias supplies (HS and LS)

## 1. Scope and inputs

This section specifies the circuit between the TMS320F28335 ePWM pins and the gates of the two Wolfspeed C4MS025120K (TO-247-4, Kelvin source) devices of the 400 V -> 200 V, 5 kW, 50 kHz synchronous buck. It follows the SKILL-001 procedure (steps 1-9) and SKILL-004 for the floating supplies, adapts the TIDA-010054 and CGD1700HB2M-UNA circuits and derives every value for this converter; the reference instance values (2 ohm / 1 ohm / 10 ohm gate resistors, 6.4 V / 1 us and 6.7 V / 46 ns DESAT settings, 20 uF per rail) are not reused (SKILL-001 known limitations; CB-GD-001 limitations).

Device data used (C4MS025120K Rev. 2, Dec 2025, fetched): V_GS(th) 2.0/2.6/3.9 V at 25 degC and 2.0 V at 175 degC; recommended V_GS +15..+18 / -5..0 V, absolute -10/+23 V; Q_G 125 nC (Q_GS 35, Q_GD 30 nC at -4/+18 V, 800 V); C_iss/C_oss/C_rss 3087/103/4.7 pF at 1000 V (ratio 630); R_G(int) 2.6 ohm; td(on)/t_r/td(off)/t_f 12/4/36/11 ns and E_on/E_off 470/64 uJ at 800 V, 39.2 A, R_G(ext) 1 ohm; V_SD 4.6 V at 175 degC; output curves (Figures 2 and 3), gate charge (Figure 12), switching energy and times versus R_G (Figures 25, 27) read from rendered pages.

## 2. Isolation and driver IC selection

Both switch positions receive their own reinforced-isolated driver (SKILL-001 principle 1; design basis isolation concept). The barrier working voltage is taken as 460 V DC (OVP trip): the HS barrier sees 0-460 V pulsed at the switch-node dv/dt, the LS barrier a quasi-static PGND. Reinforced insulation for a 600 V system in overvoltage category II requires about 6 kV impulse withstand (IEC 60664-1, KR-SN-001).

## 3. Switching dv/dt and CMTI margin

Turn-on is gate-current limited: dv/dt = (V_DD - V_pl)/((R_ON + R_int + R_OUTH) C_rss(V)). With V_pl about 7.5 V (Figure 12), C_rss about 7 pF at 400 V (4.7 pF at 1000 V) and R_ON = 10 ohm the peak is 71 V/ns (90 V/ns at 6.8 ohm), 41-53 V/ns mid-swing. Turn-off of this low-C_rss device is load-current limited: dv/dt = I_off/(2 C_oss(V)) = 28.75 A / 260 pF = 110 V/ns at 25 A (122 V/ns at the 27.5 A overload) at the top of the swing, about 48 V/ns on average; the datasheet E_off (64 uJ at 800 V / 39.2 A / 1 ohm, t_v about 4 ns) scales to a consistent 100 V/ns. Design envelope: 120 V/ns. CMTI margin 150/120 = 1.25 at the instantaneous peak and about 3x on the average slope - acceptable only with a double-pulse measurement; the mitigation path is a switch-node snubber (pads from the MOSFET agent) or a reviewed gate-Kelvin capacitor (KR-GD-010), not a lower-CMTI driver. The MOSFET agent's 20-40 V/ns turn-off estimate is not reproduced here (open issue).

## 4. Gate rails and bias supply

Rails: +15.0 V / -4.0 V, +/-1.3 % (KR-GD-001 against -10/+23 V for C4MS and -8/+19 V for the C3M0021120K fallback; REF-WS-PRD-04814 decision 1 adapted). Negative turn-off is kept (KR-GD-005): the off-state excursion from the complementary edge is bounded by the capacitance divider, dV_GS <= 400 V / 630 = 0.63 V, and by the R-limited value C_rss dv/dt R_path = 6.0 V without clamp / 3.1 V with clamp, so the real excursion is about 0.6-1.0 V. From -4 V this leaves about 5 V to the 2.0 V hot threshold; from 0 V it would leave about 1 V, which is why 0 V turn-off is rejected for this half bridge. The gate loop (L_g about 12 nH, C_iss 3.1 nF, Z0 2 ohm) is overdamped on both paths (zeta 3.8 on, 1.6 off), so V_GS extremes stay near +15.7 / -4.6 V. +18 V (C4MS only) is a resistor population option (KR-GD-006).

Power budget (KR-IS-001): P_g = Q_G f_sw (V_DD - V_EE) = 125 nC x 50 kHz x 19 V = 0.119 W; driver quiescent 5.9 mA x 19 V = 0.112 W; DESAT bias 0.06-0.07 W; pull-down and AIN 0.015 W: HS total 0.32 W. ## 5. Gate resistors, clamp and decoupling

R_G,ON = 10 ohm for bring-up (6.8 ohm tuning target), R_G,OFF = 3.3 ohm, both Panasonic ERJ-P08 1206 anti-surge (0.66 W; average 0.04 W, pulses 16-31 W for 20-30 ns). Peak currents 1.26 A source / 3.06 A sink. Figure 25 shows E_on x1.9 at 10 ohm and x1.6 at 6.8 ohm relative to the 1 ohm test value - about 3.8 W / 2.4 W more HS switching loss than the k_RG = 1.3 assumed by the MOSFET agent (handed to the efficiency budget). The internal Miller clamp is connected through a 0 ohm link with a <= 15 mm path (KR-GD-003; the Wolfspeed view that it is not strictly needed with low R_G is preserved). A 10 kohm gate-to-Kelvin resistor sits at the device side of R_G (KR-GD-007; 10 k vs 47 k alternative noted). DNP pads for a gate-Kelvin RC exist only because the package has a Kelvin source (KR-GD-010). No gate Zener (KR-GD-012).

Decoupling (KR-PCB-002): C_eff >= Q_G/dV = 125 nC / 0.1 V = 1.25 uF, times 1.5 for X7R bias loss -> 2 x 4.7 uF 25 V (VDD-COM, 20 mV droop) and 4.7 uF (COM-VEE, 30 mV) plus 100 nF at the pins, TDK C3216X7R1E475K160AC; the module output carries 2 x 4.7 uF (VDD-VEE) and 4.7 uF (COM-VEE).

## 6. DESAT protection, soft turn-off and response time

Network (CB-GD-001 topology, values re-derived): VDD -> R1 2.2 k -> node A -> US1M (1000 V, 75 ns, 10 pF) -> drain; node A -> R2 4.99 k -> OC; OC -> R3 1.0 k -> COM; C_BL 680 pF C0G; Schottky clamp COM -> OC.

V_A = V_OCTH (R2 + R3)/R3 = 0.70 x 5.99 = 4.19 V (3.77-4.61 V); V_DS,trip = V_A - V_F = 3.6 V (3.2-4.0 V). On the 175 degC output curve at V_GS = 15 V this is about 75 A (70-85 A), 3.0x rated and 2.4x the 31.6 A overload peak; at 25 degC about 135-165 A. The overload V_DS of 1.45 V gives V_OC = 0.34 V against the 0.63 V minimum threshold (1.85x). Blanking: V_th = 15 V x 1.0 k / 8.19 k = 1.831 V, R_th = 878 ohm, t_bl = -R_th C ln(1 - V_OCTH/V_th) = 252/288/326 ns, plus the IC deglitch 95-180 ns; the turn-on settling (td(on) 28 ns + V_DS fall + about 100 ns of 82 MHz ringing) is about 150 ns, 1.7x below the minimum blanking (KR-GD-004). Response: t_bl + tOCOFF (150-400 ns) + soft turn-off of 85 nC at 250-570 mA = 0.55 us min / 0.77 us typ / 1.07 us max, inside the 1.5 us budget (KR-PR-001). Wolfspeed publishes no withstand time for this device; press statements for Gen 4 ('about 2 us', 'up to 2.3 us', conditions unknown) give a ratio >= 1.9 that must be confirmed by a short-circuit test. Soft turn-off slews the gate at 0.13 V/ns, cutting an about 250 A fault current in about 39 ns (6.4 A/ns): 224 V on 35 nH, 684 V peak at 460 V, 57 % of 1200 V (KR-GD-011). One 1000 V diode suffices (1.9x at 528 V; CGD1700 used two for 1700 V). During dead time the LS drain sits at -4.6 V, pulling OC to -0.67 V unclamped versus a -0.3 V absolute minimum: the Schottky clamp carries 0.74 mA and its V_F must be <= 0.3 V (to verify).

## 7. Interlock, fault logic and dead time

IN+ of each driver takes its own PWM and IN- the complementary PWM (cross-wired interlock, KR-GD-009), with 100 ohm / 100 pF filters; open inputs yield OFF through the internal pull-down/pull-up. FLT_HS and FLT_LS are wired-AND to TZ1; RDY_HS, RDY_LS, /PG_HS, /PG_LS are ANDed to TZ2; RST/EN is a GPIO (low >= 1 us resets the latched fault, KR-PR-002); the LS APWM (380-420 kHz, 88 % at 0.6 V to 10 % at 4.5 V) goes to eCAP1 with the NTC network 3.3 k + (10 k || NTC) giving 0.73-2.6 V over -40..125 degC. Dead time: skew 30 + PWD 30 + td(off) 50 + t_f 13 - td(on) 28 = 95 ns, x1.5 -> 150 ns minimum; 250 ns at bring-up (37.5 TBCLK counts), 150-200 ns target after measurement, 400 ns upper bound (about 1.2 W per 100 ns of body-diode conduction). PWM pulses shorter than 40 ns are rejected by the driver deglitch.

## 8. Layout hand-off (SKILL-002) and double-pulse plan

Constraints are listed in pcb_constraints: driver within 15 mm of the device with decoupling inside the gate loop (KR-PCB-002/005, PE-PCB-001/008), gate/Kelvin adjacent-layer pours (KR-PCB-001), Kelvin never tied to the power source (KR-PCB-003), copper-free barriers with net classes and slots (KR-ISO-001/003/004), preliminary 10 mm / 5.5 mm distances for review (KR-ISO-002), compact shielded DESAT detection side (PRD-09301 section 6.4), control-side logic away from the switch node (PE-PCB-007). Double-pulse test items: R_G,ON sweep 4.7-15 ohm for dv/dt (<= 120 V/ns), V_DS overshoot (<= 528 V at 440 V) and E_on; R_G,OFF sweep 2.2-6.8 ohm for E_off, di/dt and undershoot; off-state V_GS during the complementary edge with and without the clamp link (PRD-06933 method); DESAT trip current versus temperature and blanking margin; fault turn-off V_DS peak; dead-time reduction; rail ripple on VDD/VEE; common-mode noise on PWM/FLT lines.
